en: 60 g buckwheat groats
150 ml water or low-fat milk
1 tsp butter or oil
A pinch of salt
1 boiled egg or vegetables (optional)
Rinse the buckwheat and toast it in the pot 2 minutes
Add the boiling water and salt
Cover and cook 15 minutes on low without stirring
Turn off the heat, rest 5 minutes, then stir in the butter
200 g low-fat cottage cheese
1 egg
20 g wholewheat flour or semolina
1 tsp honey
1 tsp oil, vanilla
Mash the cottage cheese with a fork until smooth
Mix in the egg, flour, honey and vanilla
Shape thick patties with floured hands
Cook 3 minutes per side over medium heat
Whole-wheat flour 60 g
Low-fat yogurt or kefir 80 ml
1 egg
Half a tsp baking soda and salt
Mixed fresh or frozen berries 60 g
1 tsp oil for cooking
Beat the egg with the yogurt until combined.
Gradually add the flour, baking soda and salt until you get a fairly thick, lump-free batter.
Heat a non-stick pan with a little oil, spoon small dollops of batter to form little pancakes.
Cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles appear on the surface, flip and cook 2 more minutes, and serve with the berries.
Oats 40 g
Low-fat milk 200 ml and water 50 ml
1 small apple, cubed, and half a banana
A pinch of ground cinnamon
1 tsp honey
Chopped walnuts for garnish
Put the oats with the milk and water in a small pot.
Cook over medium heat 7-8 minutes, stirring, until the texture thickens.
Add the cubed apple and cinnamon and cook 3 more minutes until the apple softens slightly.
Pour into a serving bowl, top with banana slices, add the honey and walnuts.

name.en: Manaya Kasha (Russian Semolina Porridge with Fruit)

en: Semolina 40 g
Low-fat milk 250 ml
1 tsp brown sugar and a little salt
1 small apple, cubed
A pinch of ground cinnamon
Raisins or honey for garnish (optional)
Heat the milk in a pot until near boiling.
Gradually add the semolina, stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Cook on low heat 5-6 minutes, stirring, until the texture thickens, add the brown sugar and salt.
Add the cubed apple and cinnamon, cook 2 more minutes, and serve garnished with raisins or honey.

name.en: Russian Scrambled Eggs with Dill and Sour Cream, with Bread

en: 2 eggs
Low-fat sour cream 1 tbsp
Chopped fresh dill 1 tbsp
Salt and black pepper
1 tsp oil
1 slice whole-wheat bread (30 g)
Beat the eggs with the sour cream, salt and black pepper.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat, pour in the egg mixture.
Stir gently and continuously until the eggs set while staying a little soft.
Add the chopped dill at the last moment and stir, and serve immediately with the bread.

name.en: Blini (Thin Russian Crepes) with Berry Jam

en: Whole-wheat flour 50 g
1 egg and low-fat milk 150 ml
1 tsp brown sugar and a pinch of salt
Low-sugar berry jam 2 tbsp
1 tsp oil for cooking
Low-fat sour cream to serve (optional)
Beat the egg with the milk, brown sugar and salt.
Gradually add the flour while whisking until you get a thin, smooth batter with no lumps (thinner than a regular pancake batter).
Heat a non-stick pan with a little oil, pour in a thin layer of batter and tilt to coat the base.
Cook 1 to 1.5 minutes until the edges dry out, flip and cook 30 more seconds, repeat with the rest, and serve with the jam and sour cream.

name.en: Buterbrod (Russian Open-Faced Sandwich with Egg and Cheese)

en: 2 slices whole-wheat bread (60 g)
1 boiled egg, sliced
Low-fat cheese, sliced, 30 g
1 small tomato, sliced
A little butter or low-fat sour cream for spreading
Fresh dill for garnish
Spread the bread slices with a thin layer of butter or sour cream.
Arrange the cheese slices over the bread.
Add the egg and tomato slices over the cheese.
Garnish with fresh dill, and serve immediately.
Cooked buckwheat (kasha) 150 g
1 egg
2 tbsp whole-wheat flour
Chopped spring onion, salt and black pepper
1 tsp oil for brushing
2 tbsp low-fat sour cream to serve
Mix the cooked buckwheat with the egg, flour, spring onion, salt and black pepper until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into small flat mounds on a lined tray.
Brush the tops lightly with a little oil.
Bake at 220°C for 15-18 minutes, turning halfway, until golden, and serve with the sour cream.
Millet 40 g
Pumpkin, cubed, 80 g
Low-fat milk 150 ml and water 100 ml
Honey 1 tsp
A pinch of cinnamon
A small knob of butter (optional)
Wash the millet thoroughly until the water runs clear.
Put it in a pot with the pumpkin and water, boil 10 minutes until the pumpkin softens slightly.
Add the milk and continue cooking over low heat 15 minutes, stirring, until the texture thickens and the pumpkin is fully soft.
Add the honey, cinnamon and butter if desired, pour into a serving bowl and serve warm.
2 beetroots, grated
Cabbage, 1 carrot, 1 onion, 1 potato
70 g lean beef (optional)
1 tsp oil, tomato paste
1 tbsp yogurt, dill, vinegar
Simmer the beef in 6 cups of water 40 minutes (or use vegetable stock)
Sauté the onion, carrot and beetroot with tomato paste and vinegar
Add the potato and cabbage to the broth, cook 15 minutes
Add the beetroot mixture, simmer 10 minutes, serve with yogurt and dill
100 g chicken breast
200 g shredded cabbage
1 carrot, 1 onion, 1 potato
1 tsp oil, bay leaf
Dill, parsley, black pepper
Simmer the chicken in 5 cups of water 20 minutes, then shred it
Sauté the onion and carrot in the oil
Add them to the broth with the potato, cabbage and bay leaf
Cook 20 minutes, return the chicken and add the herbs
Lean beef, cubed, 100 g
Chopped pickled cucumber 40 g and sliced green olives 15 g
1 medium onion and puréed tomato 60 g
1 tsp tomato paste and lemon juice
Light beef stock 400 ml
Fresh dill and low-fat sour cream to serve
Brown the onion in a dry pan or with very little oil until it softens.
Add the beef and stir until it changes colour, then add the tomato and tomato paste and cook 5 minutes.
Add the stock, pickled cucumber and olives, cover and simmer 30-35 minutes until the beef is tender.
Add the lemon juice, pour into serving bowls, garnish with dill and a spoonful of sour cream.

name.en: Rassolnik (Pickled Cucumber and Barley Soup with Meat)

en: Beef, small cubes, 80 g
Pearl barley 30 g
Grated pickled cucumber 60 g with a little of its brine
Potato, cubed, 100 g, and carrot and onion
Light beef stock 500 ml
Fresh dill and low-fat sour cream to serve
Boil the barley in separate water for 20 minutes until nearly tender, drain.
Brown the onion and carrot in a dry pan or with a little oil, add the beef and stir until it changes colour.
Add the stock, potato and barley, cover and simmer 25 minutes until the potato is cooked and the beef is tender.
Add the grated cucumber with a little of its brine, cook 5 more minutes, and serve with dill and sour cream.
White fish fillet (salmon or cod) 140 g
Potato, cubed, 100 g, and carrot and onion
1 small tomato, chopped
Bay leaves and black peppercorns
Light stock or water 500 ml
Fresh dill and lemon to serve
Put the onion, carrot and potato in the stock or water, cook 15 minutes until the vegetables begin to soften.
Add the tomato, bay leaves and peppercorns, cook 5 more minutes.
Add the fish and cook just 8-10 minutes until cooked without falling apart too much.
Adjust the salt, and serve hot with dill and lemon slices.

name.en: Warm Okroshka-Style Chicken and Vegetable Soup

en: Boiled chicken breast, cubed, 100 g
Boiled potato, cubed, 80 g
Fresh cucumber, cubed, 60 g, and sliced radish
Chopped spring onion and fresh dill
Low-fat yogurt 150 g and light stock 200 ml
Mild mustard half a tsp and salt
Mix the yogurt with the light stock, mustard and salt until combined to form the soup base.
Add the chicken, potato, cucumber and radish to the base.
Warm it gently over very low heat for just 5 minutes (not boiled) until warm but not hot.
Garnish with spring onion and dill, and serve warm immediately.

name.en: Kharcho (Spicy Beef, Rice and Walnut Soup)

en: Beef, small cubes, 100 g
White rice 30 g
Ground walnuts 20 g
Puréed tomato 80 g and 1 medium onion
2 crushed garlic cloves, a little hot red pepper and ground coriander
Light beef stock 500 ml and fresh coriander to serve
Brown the onion in a dry pan or with a little oil until softened.
Add the beef and stir until it changes colour, then add the tomato, garlic, red pepper and ground coriander and cook 5 minutes.
Add the stock, cover and simmer 30 minutes until the beef begins to tenderize.
Add the rice and ground walnuts, cook 15 more minutes until the rice is cooked and the beef is fully tender, and serve garnished with fresh coriander.
Low-fat kefir 300 ml
1 chopped boiled egg
Boiled potato, cubed, 80 g
Fresh cucumber, cubed, 80 g, and sliced radish
Boiled chicken breast, cubed, 60 g
Dill, chopped spring onion, salt and mild mustard
Mix the kefir with the mustard and salt until combined to form the soup base.
Add the egg, potato, cucumber, radish and chicken to the base.
Stir gently until the ingredients are evenly distributed.
Chill for at least 30 minutes, garnish with dill and spring onion, and serve cold.
Lean beef, cubed, 100 g
Pearl barley 40 g
Potato, carrot and onion, chopped, 150 g total
Bay leaf, salt and black pepper
Water or light stock 600 ml
Chopped parsley for garnish
Boil the barley in separate water for 20 minutes, drain.
Put the beef in a pot with the water or stock, boil 30 minutes until tender, skimming off any foam.
Add the potato, carrot, onion and bay leaf, cook 15 more minutes.
Add the boiled barley, salt and black pepper, cook 5 more minutes, garnish with parsley and serve hot.

name.en: Russian-Style Plov (Rice Pilaf with Beef and Carrots)

en: Lean beef, cubed, 100 g
Basmati rice 100 g
Coarsely grated carrot 100 g
1 medium onion and garlic paste
Ground cumin and ground coriander
2 tsp oil and salt
Brown the onion in the oil, add the beef, garlic paste and spices and stir until the meat changes colour.
Add the carrot and stir for 5 minutes until it softens slightly.
Add two cups of water and salt, cover and simmer 35 minutes until the beef is tender.
Add the rice on top without stirring, cover and cook on very low heat 18-20 minutes until the rice is fully cooked, gently mix before serving.
170 g white fish fillet
1 carrot, 1 potato, 1 onion, sliced
1 tbsp yogurt or light cream
1 tsp oil, lemon juice
Dill, salt, pepper
Arrange the vegetable slices in an oiled dish
Bake 20 minutes at 200°C
Season the fish with lemon and salt and lay it on top
Brush with yogurt, bake 15 minutes, scatter dill
4 large cabbage leaves
150 g lean minced meat
50 g cooked rice
1 onion, 1 grated carrot
1 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp yogurt
Blanch the cabbage leaves 2 minutes until pliable
Mix the meat with the rice, half the onion and salt
Put filling on each leaf and roll them tightly
Arrange in a pot with tomato sauce and water, cook 40 minutes
Thin lean beef slices 130 g
Sliced mushrooms 80 g
1 medium onion
Low-fat sour cream 60 g
1 tsp tomato paste and 1 tsp whole-wheat flour
Cooked white rice 100 g
Brown the onion in a non-stick pan until softened, add the mushrooms and stir for 5 minutes until they lose their moisture.
Add the beef and stir over high heat 3-4 minutes until it changes colour (don't overcook or it will toughen).
Dissolve the flour in the sour cream and tomato paste and add to the pan.
Simmer 5 minutes until the sauce thickens, and serve over the rice.

name.en: Kotleti (Russian Meat Patties) with Mashed Potatoes

en: Lean minced beef 120 g
White bread soaked in milk 30 g
1 small grated onion and 1 small crushed garlic clove
1 egg and 2 tbsp coarse breadcrumbs
Boiled mashed potato 150 g and a little milk
Salt, black pepper and 1 tsp oil for cooking
Squeeze the soaked bread of excess milk.
Mix the minced meat with the bread, onion, garlic, egg, salt and black pepper until well combined.
Shape into 4 oval patties, coat them in the breadcrumbs.
Heat a non-stick pan with the oil and cook the kotleti 5-6 minutes per side until fully done, warm the mashed potato with a little milk and serve alongside.

name.en: Zrazy (Beef Rolls Stuffed with Egg and Herbs) with Potatoes

en: Lean minced beef 120 g
Chopped boiled egg and chopped spring onion for the filling
1 raw egg and 2 tbsp breadcrumbs for the outer mixture
Boiled potato 150 g to serve
Salt and black pepper
1 tsp oil for cooking
Mix the minced meat with the raw egg, breadcrumbs, salt and black pepper until combined.
Mix the chopped boiled egg with the spring onion for the filling.
Flatten a portion of the meat in your hand, place the filling in the centre and close to form a roll, repeat with the rest.
Heat the oil and cook the zrazy 4-5 minutes per side until fully done, and serve with the boiled potato.
Whole-wheat flour 50 g, water 30 ml and salt for the dough
Lean minced beef and chicken 100 g
1 small grated onion, salt and black pepper
Light stock or water for boiling
Low-fat sour cream to serve
Fresh dill for garnish
Knead the flour with the water and salt into a firm dough, let it rest 15 minutes.
Mix the minced meat with the grated onion, salt and black pepper for the filling.
Roll the dough out very thin and cut into small circles, place a teaspoon of filling in the centre of each circle and fold in half, then press the edges together to seal into pelmeni.
Boil in stock or boiling water 7-8 minutes until they float and are cooked, serve with sour cream and dill.
Beef, small cubes, 120 g
Potato, cubed, 150 g, and carrot and onion
Puréed tomato 60 g
Bay leaf and 1 crushed garlic clove
Light stock 300 ml
Fresh dill for garnish
Brown the onion and carrot in a dry pan or with a little oil until softened.
Add the beef and stir until it changes colour, then add the tomato, garlic and bay leaf and cook 5 minutes.
Add the stock and potato, cover and simmer 35-40 minutes until the potato is cooked and the beef is fully tender.
Adjust the salt, garnish with dill, and serve hot.
Chicken breast, flattened, 150 g
Light butter mixed with crushed garlic and chopped dill, 1 tbsp
1 tbsp whole-wheat flour and 1 beaten egg
Coarse breadcrumbs 30 g
Salt and black pepper
Boiled potato or green salad to serve
Shape the butter, garlic and dill mixture into a small cylinder and chill until firm.
Flatten the chicken breast, place the butter cylinder in the centre and wrap the chicken around it tightly.
Coat it in the flour, then the beaten egg, then the breadcrumbs.
Arrange on a lined tray and bake at 200°C for 25-30 minutes until fully cooked and golden, and serve with the potato or salad.

name.en: Baked Fish Cutlets (Rybnye Kotlety) with Potatoes

en: Minced or flaked white fish fillet 150 g
1 small onion, grated
1 egg
Coarse breadcrumbs 30 g
Salt, black pepper and chopped dill
Boiled potato 150 g to serve
Mix the fish with the grated onion, egg, half the breadcrumbs, salt, black pepper and dill until well combined.
Shape the mixture into oval patties, coat them in the remaining breadcrumbs.
Arrange on a lined tray and brush with a little oil.
Bake at 220°C for 18-20 minutes, turning halfway, until golden, and serve with the boiled potato.

name.en: Baked Chicken Legs with Potatoes and Herbs

en: Skinless chicken thigh 150 g
Small potatoes, quartered, 150 g
Garlic paste and dried herbs (thyme, rosemary)
2 tsp olive oil
Salt and black pepper
Lemon slices for garnish (optional)
Season the chicken with the garlic paste, dried herbs, salt and black pepper and let it sit 15 minutes.
Arrange the quartered potatoes and chicken on a tray, drizzle with the olive oil.
Bake at 220°C for 35-40 minutes, turning the potatoes halfway, until the chicken is cooked and the potatoes are golden.
Garnish with lemon slices if desired, and serve hot.
2 boiled beetroots, grated
20 g crushed walnuts
1 garlic clove, crushed
1 tbsp yogurt
1 tsp oil, vinegar, salt
Grate the cooled boiled beetroot
Mix the yogurt, garlic, oil, vinegar and salt
Toss the beetroot thoroughly in the dressing
Add the walnuts just before serving so they stay crunchy
200 ml kefir or buttermilk
Half cup cranberries or blueberries
1 tsp honey
1 tbsp oats
A pinch of cinnamon
Mash half the berries with a fork
Stir them into the kefir with the honey
Add the oats and let them soften 5 minutes
Top with the remaining berries and cinnamon
Boiled beet, cubed, 60 g
Boiled potato, cubed, 60 g, and boiled carrot 40 g
Pickled cucumber, cubed, 40 g
Boiled peas 30 g
1 tbsp finely chopped red onion
1 tsp olive oil, salt and a light squeeze of lemon juice
Boil the beet, potato and carrot separately until cooked, let them cool then cut into small cubes.
Mix the beet, potato and carrot with the pickled cucumber, peas and red onion.
Add the olive oil, salt and lemon juice and toss gently.
Chill for 15 minutes before serving to let the flavours meld.

name.en: Light Shuba (Layered Herring and Vegetable Salad)

en: Lightly salted herring fillet, chopped, 50 g (or smoked white fish as an alternative)
Grated boiled beet 60 g
Grated boiled potato 50 g and grated boiled carrot 40 g
1 small onion, finely chopped
Low-fat yogurt 40 g as a mayonnaise substitute
Fresh dill for garnish
Arrange the chopped herring at the bottom of a serving dish with the chopped onion over it.
Spread a layer of grated potato, then a thin layer of yogurt.
Add a layer of carrot then a layer of yogurt, and finally a layer of grated beet.
Cover the surface with a thin layer of yogurt, garnish with dill, and chill for at least an hour before serving.
Carrot, finely julienned, 150 g
2 crushed garlic cloves
1 tsp oil and 1 tsp apple cider vinegar
Ground coriander, a little hot red pepper and salt
A pinch of brown sugar
Chopped fresh coriander for garnish
Put the grated carrot in a bowl and sprinkle with a little salt, let it sit 10 minutes then gently squeeze out excess water.
Heat the oil in a very small pan and add the ground coriander and red pepper for a few seconds until fragrant.
Pour the hot oil directly over the carrot, add the crushed garlic, vinegar and brown sugar.
Mix well and chill for at least an hour before serving, garnish with fresh coriander.

name.en: Small Baked Pirozhki with Potato and Cheese

en: Whole-wheat flour 50 g and instant yeast a quarter tsp
Warm milk 30 ml and 1 tsp oil for the dough
Boiled mashed potato 80 g and grated low-fat cheese 30 g
Chopped spring onion, salt and black pepper
1 beaten egg for brushing
Sesame seeds for garnish (optional)
Dissolve the yeast in the warm milk and let it sit 5 minutes, knead with the flour and oil into a soft dough, let it rest in a warm place 45 minutes.
Mix the mashed potato with the cheese, spring onion, salt and black pepper for the filling.
Divide the dough into three balls, roll each into a small disc, place the filling in the centre and seal tightly.
Arrange on a lined tray, brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame if desired, and bake at 190°C for 18-20 minutes until golden.

name.en: Baked Draniki (Russian Potato Pancakes) with Sour Cream

en: Grated potato, squeezed of liquid, 200 g
1 small onion, grated
1 egg
2 tbsp whole-wheat flour
Salt and black pepper
2 tbsp low-fat sour cream to serve
Mix the squeezed potato with the grated onion, egg, flour, salt and black pepper until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into small flat mounds on a lined tray.
Brush the tops lightly with a little oil.
Bake at 220°C for 18-20 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp, and serve with the sour cream.
Chopped mushrooms 150 g
1 small onion, chopped
Ready-made or homemade whole-wheat dough 100 g
Salt, black pepper and dried herbs
1 tsp oil for sautéing and brushing
Beaten egg for brushing
Heat the oil and sauté the onion until softened, add the mushrooms and cook 8-10 minutes until they lose their excess water.
Add the salt, black pepper and herbs, let the filling cool.
Roll out the dough and cut into circles, place a spoonful of filling in the centre, close into a half-moon and press the edges firmly.
Arrange on a lined tray, brush with the beaten egg, and bake at 200°C for 18-20 minutes until golden.
Low-fat cottage cheese 150 g
Grated low-fat hard cheese 40 g
1 egg
2 tbsp whole-wheat flour
Salt and chopped dill
2 tbsp coarse breadcrumbs for coating
Mix the cottage cheese with the grated hard cheese, egg, flour, salt and dill until well combined.
Shape the mixture into small walnut-sized balls.
Coat them in the breadcrumbs until fully covered.
Arrange on a lined tray, and bake at 200°C for 15-18 minutes, turning halfway, until golden.
Rye or whole-wheat flour 50 g
Warm water 2 tbsp and a pinch of salt for the dough
Mashed boiled potato 100 g
Low-fat milk 2 tbsp and salt for the filling
1 tbsp low-fat sour cream for brushing before baking
Chopped spring onion for garnish
Knead the flour with the warm water and salt into a soft dough, let it rest 10 minutes.
Mix the mashed potato with the milk and salt for the filling.
Roll out the dough into small round discs, place the filling in the centre and fold the edges slightly to form an open shape.
Brush with the sour cream, arrange on a lined tray, and bake at 220°C for 12-15 minutes until the edges are golden, garnish with spring onion.
1 large apple
10 g crushed walnuts
1 tsp honey
A pinch of cinnamon
1 tbsp yogurt to serve
Core the apple without piercing the bottom
Fill the cavity with walnuts, honey and cinnamon
Place it in a dish with 2 tbsp of water
Bake 30 minutes at 180°C and serve with yogurt
150 g mixed berries (fresh or frozen)
2 cups water
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 tsp honey
A few drops of lemon juice
Simmer the berries in 1.5 cups of water for 8 minutes
Strain and press the berries to extract the juice
Dissolve the cornstarch in half a cup of cold water
Return the juice to the heat and stir in the starch until it thickens
1 egg
Honey 2 tbsp and brown sugar 20 g
A quarter tsp baking soda
Whole-wheat flour 60 g
Low-fat sour cream or Greek yogurt 100 g for the filling
1 extra tsp honey for the filling
Beat the egg with the brown sugar until pale and frothy.
Warm the honey slightly (warm, not hot) and add the baking soda to it, it will foam a bit, mix it into the egg mixture.
Gradually add the flour and knead into a soft dough, roll it out very thin and bake on a lined tray at 180°C for 7-8 minutes until golden, repeat to get two or three layers.
Mix the sour cream with the extra honey, spread the filling between the cake layers, chill for at least two hours before slicing to let it soften.
Whole-wheat flour 50 g
Instant yeast half a tsp and warm milk 30 ml
Brown sugar 1 tsp for the dough and 1 tbsp for the filling
Low-fat cottage cheese 80 g
1 egg (half for the dough, half for the filling)
1 tbsp raisins (optional)
Dissolve the yeast and sugar in the warm milk and let it sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Knead the flour with the yeast mixture and half the egg into a soft dough, let it rest in a warm place 45 minutes until it doubles in size.
Mix the cottage cheese with the other half of the egg, the brown sugar and the raisins for the filling.
Shape the dough into a ball, press the centre with a spoon to form a well, fill it with the filling, let the dough rest 15 more minutes, then bake at 180°C for 18-20 minutes until golden.
2 medium apples, thinly sliced
2 eggs
Brown sugar 40 g
Whole-wheat flour 50 g and baking powder a quarter tsp
A pinch of ground cinnamon
1 tsp oil for the tin
Beat the eggs with the brown sugar with an electric whisk 5 minutes until thick and pale, nearly doubling in volume.
Gently fold in the flour and baking powder with a spoon until it disappears without deflating the mixture.
Grease a small tin with oil, arrange the apple slices at the bottom, pour the batter over them and sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake at 180°C for 30-35 minutes until cooked and it springs back when pressed gently, let cool slightly before slicing.

name.en: Light Cottage Cheese Dessert with Berries

en: Low-fat cottage cheese 120 g
Honey 1 tbsp
A pinch of ground cinnamon
Mixed fresh or frozen berries 70 g
Chopped walnuts 10 g for garnish
Half a tsp vanilla extract (optional)
Mix the cottage cheese with the honey, cinnamon and vanilla extract if using until smooth and creamy.
Spoon it into a serving bowl.
Arrange the berries on top.
Garnish with the chopped walnuts, and serve immediately or after chilling briefly.
Whole-wheat flour 60 g
Honey 2 tbsp
1 egg
Cinnamon, ground ginger and ground cloves, a pinch of each
A pinch of baking soda
Icing sugar 1 tsp for garnish (optional)
Beat the egg with the honey until combined.
Add the spices and baking soda and mix.
Gradually add the flour and knead until you get a soft, non-sticky dough.
Shape into small flat balls, arrange on a lined tray, and bake at 180°C for 12-15 minutes until done, dust with icing sugar once cooled if desired.
Low-fat cottage cheese 200 g
1 egg
Brown sugar 2 tbsp
Semolina or whole-wheat flour 2 tbsp
Raisins 1 tbsp (optional)
Low-fat sour cream 1 tbsp to serve
Mix the cottage cheese with the egg, brown sugar and semolina until combined.
Add the raisins if desired and mix gently.
Pour the mixture into a small tin lightly greased with oil.
Bake at 180°C for 30-35 minutes until the top is golden and set, let cool slightly, slice and serve with the sour cream.

name.en: Baked Pears with Honey and Cinnamon

en: 1 medium firm pear
Honey 1 tbsp
A pinch of ground cinnamon
Coarsely chopped walnuts 10 g
A little lemon juice
2 tbsp water for the tray
Cut the pear in half lengthwise and remove the core with a teaspoon to form a cavity.
Drizzle with lemon juice to prevent browning.
Place in a baking dish, pour the honey into the cavity, sprinkle with cinnamon and walnuts.
Add the water to the bottom of the dish, bake at 190°C for 25-30 minutes until softened, and serve warm.
Baked, mashed apple purée 150 g
1 egg white
Brown sugar 40 g
Half a tsp agar agar (or gelatin as a substitute)
2 tbsp water to dissolve the agar
A little vanilla extract
Dissolve the agar in the water and let it swell 5 minutes, then heat gently until fully dissolved.
Whisk the egg white until stiff, gradually add half the brown sugar and keep whisking until glossy.
Mix the apple purée with the remaining sugar and vanilla, add the hot dissolved agar and mix, then gently fold in the egg white mixture.
Pour the mixture into a piping bag and pipe small pieces onto a lined tray, let them set in the fridge 3-4 hours until firm.
